label: EU-aiact-sandboxes-2026 Article 4

obligations.text: Competent authorities shall record in a secure manner in accordance with applicable Union and national law the activities related to participation in an AI regulatory sandbox, and maintain records related to AI systems developed or tested in that sandbox.
Where necessary for their monitoring and supervisory tasks, competent authorities shall also be entitled to request additional relevant information from the participants.

Competent authorities shall provide the Commission with all relevant information related to AI regulatory sandboxes as referred to in Article 57(17) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 for publication on the single information platform.
The duration of the participation in the AI regulatory sandbox shall be proportionate to the set-up and operation of the sandbox, taking into account, in particular, the following elements:

Competent authorities shall cooperate, as appropriate, with and facilitate the involvement of the relevant actors within the AI ecosystem referred to in Article 58(2)(f) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, such as the Testing and Experimentation Facilities, the European Digital Innovation Hubs, centres of excellences, and AI Factories.

In the implementation of the AI regulatory sandboxes, competent authorities shall, as appropriate, leverage the existing Union and national AI ecosystem initiatives and infrastructure, including through regulatory supervision of specific projects within the AI regulatory sandboxes that may be carried out in those facilities, where appropriate.

Competent authorities shall ensure that any person involved in an AI regulatory sandbox project is bound by appropriate confidentiality obligations, without prejudice to Article 57(7), (8), (16) and (17) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and applicable Union or national law on transparency and access to documents.
